additional_info.subject: (ES020001) Exit - La Gineta // MP / P1 170000133 // Pantalla en negro
additional_info.body:
Buenas tardes.
Hemos detectado que el cargador MP / P1 170000133 situado en:
Exit - La Gineta
A-31 (salida 52) La Gineta 02110
https://maps.app.goo.gl/LYWC3hN7AvSSbPSp9
Presenta la pantalla en negro, aunque tiene luminosidad en el panel.
Hemos reiniciado completamente el cargador, pero la pantalla sigue mostrando los mismos síntomas, y en ningún momento aparece ningún mensaje o imagen en pantalla.
Adjunto imagen tomada hoy con el cargador encendido.
Necesitamos que se solucione el problema, ya que los usuarios no pueden iniciar carga por RFID con normalidad.
Gracias.

additional_info.subject: RE: (ES020001) Exit - La Gineta // MP / P1 170000133 // Pantalla en negro CRM:02023000529
additional_info.body:
Hello Fernando,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P1 170000133
Charger ID/Serial No.:
9yZMnV
Problem Description:
Black Screen
There is also a possibility that the DPP or USB cable may be faulty. We recommend swapping them with working cables to confirm the issue. During the site visit, please carry a spare HMI, DPP, and USB cables in case replacements are needed.
1.We need to check if 24v and 0v are available.
2.If 24V and 0V are missing:
For 24V, verify that the connections for XD23, XD8, and XD21 are secure and organized according to the schematic. Additionally, check if FC14 has tripped (you can provide a photo).
For 0V, ensure that the connections for XD22 and XD4 are tight and properly arranged.
Kindly refer to the marked HMI schematic below and also review the attached Q-feedback for troubleshooting.
SI E Q-Feedback Q2301 Sicharge D - HMI Blackout Due To RFID Illumination - ID: 109816643 - Industry Support Siemens
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [1/7/2024], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
